title: Contract risk review
brief: A clause-by-clause risk review of a realistic 12-clause manufacturing and supply agreement between Atelier Nord SAS (fictional French hardware startup) and Shenzhen Brightline Electronics Ltd (fictional OEM): each key clause excerpt reproduced, flagged red/amber/green with why it bites and the proposed redline, covering IP ownership, tooling, MOQs, liability caps, warranty, termination, governing law and arbitration, ending with a tiered negotiation priority list — French-law lens, plain English, visible demo disclaimer.
da: White-shoe counsel letterhead: ivory sheet, deep navy with oxblood accents, tracked small-caps masthead, Source Serif 4 body, indented clause quotes, risk chips in the margin, del/ins redlines.
